entities.name: Methionyl-tRNA formyltransferase
observations: The 328-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q147A4 from Paraburkholderia xenovorans.
Catalyzes transfer of a formyl group from 10-formyltetrahydrofolate to methionyl-tRNA(fMet), producing N-formylmethionyl-tRNA(fMet).
Annotated EC 2.1.2.9 and GO molecular function GO:0004479; cytosolic localization GO:0005829 in reference proteins.
Sequence contains Pfam Formyl_trans_N (PF00551) at residues 7–192 and Formyl_trans_C (PF02911) at residues 216–314.
Reference proteins report a binding-site feature at residues 121–124; positions are reference annotations and should not be overinterpreted beyond the exact-match case.
